Package parking.domain.model

Class Car

java.lang.Object
parking.domain.model.Vehicle
parking.domain.model.Car
public class Car extends Vehicle
A regular passenger car.

Charged 900L per billable hour, capped at 7000L per 24-hour period once the stay reaches 10L billable hours, and requires a SpaceType.CAR space.

    • getRate

      public Rate getRate()
      Returns the fee-calculation strategy for this vehicle.

      Each subclass composes and returns its own Rate instance (see the Strategy/Decorator collaboration in RateWithDailyCap); callers must never attempt to infer or duplicate this logic themselves.

      Specified by:
      getRate in class Vehicle
      Returns:
      a new RateWithDailyCap wrapping an HourlyRate configured with this class's constants
